name: SOL Moon Landing Bridge
milestone: Moon-only SOL landing proof through inherited surface lifecycle
solLandingPolicy: Earth Moon only in v0.1.0.5C via inherited airless-rocky landing/surface profile; every other SOL world remains landing-disabled
surfaceSkyObserverPolicy: massless body-fixed observer remains available on supported solid SOL reference worlds; spacecraft remains in live Newtonian flight
surfaceSkyTerrainPolicy: flat schematic horizon only; no claim of real terrain, geology, POIs, weather or landing capability
surfaceSkyAstronomyPolicy: reuse inherited AstronomicalObserverModel, body rotation, physical angular size, phase and finite-disk eclipse/occultation geometry
moonDefaultSitePolicy: sub-parent body-fixed point at current simulation epoch
planetDefaultSitePolicy: body-fixed point beneath current spacecraft direction
surfaceSkySavePolicy: observer camera is not serialized as a landed surface session; physical ship/system save state remains canonical
flightNavigationPolicy: Newtonian gravity/integrator, ship dynamics, flight computer, FRAME/transit, SOL reference states, eclipse/phase astronomy and Surface Sky geometry remain unchanged from v0.1.0.5B.2
mobileCachePolicy: version every changed runtime import edge for Safari/GitHub Pages, including the Moon landing surface-support/system-map/orbit-insertion chain
scope: Moon-only SOL landing bridge. No Earth/Mars/Europa/Titan/Triton landing enablement and no new landing engine.
surfaceSkyPresentationPolicy: physical angular sizes remain authoritative; presentation adds Saturn main rings, target-centering controls and bounded camera FOV only
saturnRingPresentation: main C/B/A rings rendered at NASA/NSSDCA radial ratios with Cassini Division preserved; ring plane follows canonical Saturn spin axis; no ring particle dynamics/self-shadow/radiative transfer
surfaceSkyRingPolicy: Saturn C/B/A main rings are presentation geometry scaled from published Saturn-radius ratios; ring particles are not individual gravity sources
surfaceSkyFovPolicy: camera-only FOV presets 70/35/15/5/1.5 degrees; no celestial position, radius, orbit or spacecraft state is modified
surfaceSkyFocusPolicy: NEXT cycles finite celestial targets without altering their geometry; CENTER changes observer yaw/pitch only; below-horizon targets are explicitly labeled instead of silently omitted.
moonLandingSurfacePolicy: Moon mass/radius/gravity/rotation and live sky remain authoritative SOL state; local regolith terrain/geology are deterministic procedural proxies, not a real lunar topographic map
moonLandingTransitionPolicy: reuse inherited scripted descent → touchdown → on-foot exploration → BOARD/TAKEOFF → Hill-screened circular return-orbit handoff
